messages:
sam: Quick sync — proposing a gated rollout for FlashAttention v2->v3 integration. Draft stage gates below, want ops + perf on-call to eyeball before we flip anything.

maria: +1. Can you paste the short checklist? I want to make sure console dashboards have the right panels.

sam: Checklist (high level): 1) kernel chooser fflags live 2) telemetry sampling at 100% for canary 3) KV-cache warmup/eviction sanity 4) batching window smoke 5) rollback/auto-fallback policy.

liam: For batching heuristics, we'll keep the current dynamic window but add a short-circuit for batch_size<=4 to avoid v3 overhead on micro requests. Also need to verify async batching metrics.

zoe: KV cache behavior note: v3's paged-attn causes slightly different cache hit patterns — recommend temporarily increasing prefix cache TTL by +20% during canary to avoid cold-start noise.

perf-bot: Automated profile run (summary):
```
model: redwood/llama-like-13b
seq: 2048
kernel: flashv2 (baseline) -> flashv3 (candidate)
latency p50: 38ms -> 36ms (-5%)
latency p95: 210ms -> 240ms (+14%)
token throughput: 4200 tok/s -> 4400 tok/s (+4.8%)
mem GPU: 12.8GB -> 12.0GB (-6%)
notes: tail regressions on long seqs, investigate fused kernels and crossblock sync
```

sam: That p95 bump on long sequences is the main risk. We should gate on p95 <= +8% vs baseline over 1h sliding window. If exceeded, auto-fallback to flashv2 for affected routes.

maria: Agree. Also add a KV-miss rate guard: if cache miss rate increases > 30% relative to baseline for a route, pause rollout for that route.

liam: Ops checklist for rollout automation:
- Create fflag: `attn.kernel_force=flashv3` (staged per-route)
- Kernel chooser fallback: prefer flashv3, but if p95_alert OR kv_miss_surge -> switch to flashv2
- Canary stages: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 2h hold at each stage
- Metric windows: 1h sliding for p95, 15m for error spikes

zoe: Paged-attn fallback triggers: if OOMs or extreme slowdown observed on paged paths, flip `attn.kernel_allow_paged=false` and force fused-attn path. Also ensure logs include `kernel_variant` tag for traceability.

perf-bot: Suggested alert rules (examples):
- `/alerts/p95_regress` -> fired if p95(candidate)/p95(baseline) > 1.08 for 60m
- `/alerts/kv_surge` -> fired if cache_miss_rate(candidate) - cache_miss_rate(baseline) > 0.30 for 15m
- `/alerts/oom_kernel` -> fired on GPU_OOM events tagged with kernel_variant==flashv3

sam: Smoke test commands for canary (run from staging-runbook):
```
# run shortseq and longseq mixes
./run_perf.sh --model redwood/llama-like-13b --seq-mix small:80,long:20 --dur 60
# check metrics
curl 'https://console/api/metrics?q=kernel_variant%3D%22flashv3%22%20AND%20route%3D%22chat%22&range=1h'
```

maria: Will add dashboards: per-route p50/p95, kv_miss_rate, batch_size_dist, avg_batch_latency, kernel_variant breakdown. Also add an annotation layer for each canary stage.

liam: Small ops note: make sure the kernel chooser has a one-shot warmup probe: when flipping a route to flashv3, send a synthetic request that forces KV warm cache to avoid noisy first-user regressions.

zoe: Rollout schedule proposal: begin Friday 09:00 UTC, 0.5% for 2h, then 5% for 4h, 25% for 12h (during business hours), 100% next day if all gates pass. Hold windows between each stage and manual signoff if any alerts fire.

sam: Final action items: maria adds dashboards + annotations, liam wires fflags + auto-fallback, zoe configures KV TTL tweak and warmup probe, ops on-call runs initial smoke tonight in staging, perf team will monitor sliding p95 and post a follow-up. I'll post the rollout PR when the pieces are done. :thumbsup:

maria: copying checklist to the runbook now.

liam: I'll own the fflag rollout automation.

zoe: I'll schedule warmup probe job.

perf-bot: Canary preflight results: all checks green except p95_smoke_on_longseq=warn (14% regress) -> requires tuning of fused kernels before production ramp.

sam: Thanks — let's resolve the fused kernel tail first, schedule a short triage tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

maria: ack.

liam: ack.

zoe: ack.
